up: For the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4616590, retrieve all distinct molecules reported in that document. For each molecule, provide the following fields: molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES. Include molecules even if they do not have a canonical SMILES. Return each molecule only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4616590';
